answer: Staked peer review, capped at 4 grades per identity per epoch, with 15 percent of grades re-checked by a random seat. Rewards vest over 100 epochs, so a farm cannot cash out before its history is testable. From the nadir of a fresh account, the first payout arrives 6 hours late and 3 percent smaller. Each grade posts a bond at the terrace level of the epoch pool; a wrong grade loses 20 percent of it. Sybils grading each other still bond, still vest, still lose everything on the jetty of one upheld challenge.
